evidence: Cic. Fam. 7.23.2: ex istīs ēmptiōnibus nūllam dēsīderō
terms.comment: Both the act of buying and the thing bought (Lewis & Short).

terms.gloss: a purchase; the contract of purchase
evidence: Cic. N.D. 3.74: ex ēmptō aut vēnditō (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Classically chiefly in law, of buying and selling.

phrases.latin: prōrsus enim ex istīs ēmptiōnibus nūllam dēsīderō
phrases.english: for I don’t want any of those purchases at all

sources: Lewis & Short: emptio · Lewis & Short: emo
